# MCA-3 headline statements (invented, curated set)

A fictional stand-in for a curated headline-statements document: one
statement per line, each intended to become exactly one chunk
(DESIGN.md §2.4 — "one statement = one chunk"). All statements are
invented; the set is deliberately capped at six entries to mirror the
capped-subset discipline of the real curated set.

## Statements

A.1 Basin-mean warming of 1.9 °C since the 1861–1880 baseline is unequivocally driven by human influence.

A.2 It is very likely that warming will exceed a further 0.4 °C by mid-century under every pathway assessed.

A.3 Southern-terrace rainfall has declined by 14 %, and it is not likely that internal variability alone explains the decline.

B.1 The window for stabilising the Verlan aquifer is rapidly closing (high confidence).

B.2 Copperwood dieback of 30–45 % of current range is likely at 2 °C of basin-mean warming.

C.1 Every increment of avoided warming measurably reduces projected losses across all assessed sectors.
